description: Bounty: Lone Gun: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Venn's transponder is live in {system}. He has two wingmen. Go and collect.
Bounty target is in {system}. Short job, if he stays where he is.
{client} wants Venn. Two escorts, one gunship, no patience.
success: Venn is gone. Collect the bounty, {captain}.
Target confirmed destroyed. {client} will wire the payment.
That is Venn finished. Well flown.
failure: Venn is still out there. The bounty stands, but you will not be claiming it today.
You are beaten off. Venn keeps flying.
radio-hunt: Contact. Venn's gunship and two wingmen.
That is him. Gunship, with company.
radio-backup: Two more {enemy} ships coming up behind.
Reinforcements, astern. Do not let them pin you.
